description: Develop Folder の品質ゲート

hooks.command: dir="$PWD"; while [ ! -f "$dir/.codex/hooks/readme-drift-check.py" ]; do parent="$(dirname "$dir")"; [ "$parent" = "$dir" ] && exit 0; dir="$parent"; done; [ -e "$dir/.git" ] || exit 0; /usr/bin/python3 "$dir/.codex/hooks/readme-drift-check.py"
hooks.statusMessage: progress.md と README の整合性を確認中
